name: Gilded Sigil
description: An open-work gold sigil over deep indigo, built as a seer's ceremonial instrument.
notes: All layers use a centered 512 x 512 RGBA canvas. Cardinal letters are baked into the fixed open-work ring. The violet-inlaid ceremonial lance has 4.23x the opaque mass of the cyan wind crescent.

orientationConventions.ring: Static north-up open-work card. N is baked into the upper gold crown.
orientationConventions.headingPointer: The broad gold flame-lance points to 12 o'clock at heading 0. Its violet boss is centered at (0.5, 0.5); rotate it by pure player world bearing.
orientationConventions.windPointer: The slim cyan crescent points to 12 o'clock at wind bearing 0. Its pivot is centered at (0.5, 0.5); rotate it by pure wind-toward world bearing.
orientationConventions.lubberMarker: Optional static top accent for the north index. It does not replace the heading pointer.
